frequency_question: What proportion of bilateral transboundary water treaties reaching a major renewal milestone are formally extended rather than allowed to lapse or terminate?
membership_rule: Includes formal state-to-state treaties governing shared river basins with explicit expiration or renegotiation clauses. Excludes unratified declarations, internal water compacts, and non-river resource pacts.
